jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Open Models
jobs.excerpt: We’re hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to drive technical engagement with customers and partners across our AI Software Segment Solutions Architecture team, focused on open-weight AI models.
jobs.description:
We’re hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to drive technical engagement with customers and partners across our AI Software Segment Solutions Architecture team, focused on open-weight AI models. You’ll connect real-world customer workloads to NVIDIA’s open-weight model and software ecosystem, helping developers and enterprises adopt and scale our platforms. . We’re looking for someone with strong technical depth who can serve as a trusted advisor, bridge complex challenges to innovative solutions, and grow into a strategic resource for the customers and partners you support. If you’re passionate about applied technology and enabling others to succeed with advanced platforms, we’d love to hear from you!


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor who understands complex or large-scale customer workloads and maps them to NVIDIA’s technology stack to achieve measurable outcomes.
  • Co-design advanced, scalable architectures with customers and partners, defining technical direction, integration achievements, and deployment plans.
  • Engage hands-on with deep technical topics—designing, validating, and supporting solutions that enable customer and partner success.
  • Lead technical engagements, helping customers resolve sophisticated issues, and advocate for their technical needs.
  • Partner multi-functionally with engineering and product teams to ensure successful deployment and continuous improvement of NVIDIA solutions.
  • Run end-to-end post-training programs with enterprise customers. This includes supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (GRPO, DPO, PPO), LoRA / PEFT, data curation, synthetic data generation, reward design, and evaluation design.
  • Build evaluation environments that give customers an objective measure of post-training progress. These environments feed field signal back to Product and Research, improving the next generation of open-weight models.
  • Scale our impact by building reusable recipes, reference pipelines, and playbooks that let other teams succeed. Senior Solutions Architects also mentor other SAs and raise the technical bar on review and customer-facing deliverables.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of professional experience in Industry background spanning software/hardware engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architecture, or product management — with 3-5+ years of direct, hands-on experience in open-weight model customization — including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (GRPO, DPO, PPO), LoRA / PEFT, data curation, synthetic data generation, reward design, and evaluation design.
  • Deep technical expertise in AI/ML and open-weight model post-training, with a track record of driving customer engagements and contributing to software platforms, systems, and libraries.
  • Shown ability to communicate sophisticated technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, from engineers to C-level executives.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a dedication to helping customers succeed.
  • Proven success in balancing insight for customer and partner needs with the ability to drive complex product decisions through positive relationships.
  • Experience leading complex, ambiguous customer engagements, proactively pushing them forward. Proficiency with agent-assisted model training workflows and comfort using AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to build, debug, and iterate on training and evaluation pipelines. Expertise in distributed computing, including launching and debugging multi-node training and evaluation jobs on SLURM or Kubernetes.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • A hands-on technical expert and problem solver who can clearly describe solution paths for complex challenges.
  • History of enabling customers and/or partners to optimally adopt NVIDIA technologies and platforms.
  • A technical vision that influences research, product, and engineering decisions and drives production outcomes.
  • Experience with and/or contributions to open-source NVIDIA AI libraries and models, particularly Nemotron, NeMo, NeMo-RL, and NeMo Gym. Hands-on experience designing agent environments, synthetic data pipelines, and verifiable rewards for RL post-training, or using serverless post-training APIs such as Tinker.
  • Hands-on experience customizing open-weight models (Nemotron, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi), or AI model training applied to multimodal data. Experience designing benchmarks and evaluation harnesses that were adopted by other teams.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 14, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director of Quality
jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryPosition SummaryThe Director of Quality is an execution-focused leader responsible for translating WellBe’s enterprise quality strategy into disciplined, measurable operations across markets and health plan contracts.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Position Summary

The Director of Quality is an execution-focused leader responsible for translating WellBe’s enterprise quality strategy into disciplined, measurable operations across markets and health plan contracts.

This role leads the day-to-day Quality function, manages and develops team members, and redesigns care-gap closure workflows to be simpler, standardized, scalable, and integrated into clinical practice.

The Director partners closely with market, clinical, pharmacy, analytics, technology, coding, and health plan stakeholders to improve HEDIS and Medicare Advantage Stars performance, strengthen data reliability, increase frontline accountability, and ensure the organization consistently converts quality insights into action.

Job Description

Essential Duties and ResponsibilitiesLead day-to-day execution of the Quality program across Part C and Part D, converting enterprise goals into clear workplans, owners, timelines, operating rhythms, and measurable results.Directly manage, coach, and performance-manage Quality team members; establish clear productivity, quality, service, and accountability standards.Map end-to-end care-gap closure workflows across measures, markets, and health plan contracts; identify handoffs, rework, manual steps, failure points, and unnecessary variation.Redesign and standardize workflows so care-gap identification, outreach, documentation, closure, submission, and reconciliation are consistently executed and sustainable at scale.Engage Markets using structured working sessions that diagnose barriers, assign actions, monitor commitments, and drive closure at the patient, provider, measure, and market levels.Partner with clinical operations and technology teams to surface prioritized care gaps at the point of care and embed closure activities into APP workflows.Lead implementation and adoption of Quality workflow tools, including in-house technologies, point-of-care solutions, telephony or workforce-management tools, and future AI-enabled capabilities.Oversee HEDIS chart abstraction, primary source validation, medical record retrieval, supplemental data submissions, and health plan audit support, with an emphasis on accuracy, timeliness, and reduced manual effort.Manage medication adherence and other Part D outreach operations; use performance and workflow data to improve productivity, assess capacity, and inform staffing decisions.Partner with analytics, IT, and health plan teams to strengthen WellBe-owned quality reporting using claims, EMR, pharmacy, and supplemental data; reconcile numerator, denominator, timing, and data-integrity differences.Use market-, provider-, measure-, and patient-level data to prioritize interventions, forecast performance, monitor outcomes, and adjust tactics quickly when results are off track.Evaluate and implement practical automation and AI-assisted solutions that reduce repetitive work, improve chart-review efficiency, and allow the team to focus on higher-value intervention and market partnership.Own point-of-care solution assessment and implementation, including identification of operational pain points, vendor coordination, rollout planning, training, adoption, and performance monitoring.Maintain current knowledge of NCQA, HEDIS, CMS, Stars, and applicable health plan requirements; ensure workflows, documentation, submissions, and controls remain compliant.Build effective cross-functional relationships and drive decisions with stakeholders across clinical operations, pharmacy, coding, analytics, technology, finance, compliance, markets, and external vendors.

Job Requirements

Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in nursing, healthcare administration, public health, health sciences, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Experience: Seven or more years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, managed care, provider operations, population health, HEDIS, or Medicare Advantage Stars, including 3–5 years of people-management experience. Demonstrated experience setting expectations, coaching team members, managing performance, delivering measurable operational results, and mapping, redesigning, implementing, and sustaining complex workflows across multiple teams, markets, or contracts.

Skills: Strong working knowledge of NCQA HEDIS specifications, Medicare Advantage Stars, care-gap closure, medical record review, supplemental data, and quality operations. Proven ability to move between strategy and execution, manage multiple priorities, remove barriers, and deliver results in a fast-paced, matrixed organization. Strong people leadership, change-management, project-management, process-improvement, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and presentation tools; experience with workflow platforms, reporting tools, automation, or AI-enabled healthcare solutions preferred. High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to maintain confidentiality.

Physical and Mental Requirements

  • Ability to stand or sit for extended periods.

  • Visual acuity and fine motor.

  • Ability to travel locally or nationally as needed.

Work Environment

This role operates in a corporate, primarily remote environment and requires frequent collaboration across functions, markets, and external partners. Occasional travel and schedule flexibility may be required to support market operations, implementations, audits, and business priorities. No routine on-call responsibilities are expected.

Sponsorship Statement

WellBe does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Pay Transparency Statement

Compensation for this position will be disclosed in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

Safety-Sensitive Statement

This position has been designated as safety-sensitive. As such, the employee must be able to perform job duties in a manner that ensures the safety of themselves, coworkers, patients, and the public. The role requires full cognitive and physical functioning at all times.

Employees in safety-sensitive positions are subject to drug and alcohol testing, including for substances that may impair judgment or motor function, in accordance with applicable federal and state laws and company policy. Due to the safety-sensitive nature of this role and in alignment with federal law and workplace safety standards, the use of marijuana—including medical or recreational use—is prohibited. WellBe Senior Medical will comply with applicable state laws regarding medical marijuana and reasonable accommodations, where such laws do not conflict with safety requirements or federal regulations.

Drug Screening Requirement

As a condition of employment, WellBe Senior Medical requires all candidates to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Ongoing employment may also be contingent upon compliance with the company’s Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which includes random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion drug testing. The company reserves the right to test for substances that may impair an employee’s ability to safely and effectively perform their job duties.

Background Check Statement

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by law. As a healthcare organization, WellBe conducts monthly FACIS (Fraud and Abuse Control Information System) checks on all employees. Continued employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of these checks, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

WellBe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Americans with Disabilities Act

WellBe Senior Medical is committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. If you require an accommodation during the application, interview or employment process, please contact Human Resources at

At-Will Employment Statement

Employment with WellBe is at-will unless otherwise specified by contract. This job description does not constitute an employment contract.

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

jobs.description:
IMPORTANT: after you apply, please check your email. We sendyou a link to complete your application — it is not considered until that laststep is done. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands, Singapore.

Pay: $80–$125/hr

Role Title: Family Medicine Hospitalist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

We are engaging Family Medicine Hospitalist Physicians to contribute their medical expertise to a customer project focused on inpatient care and documentation standards. In this role, you’ll apply your broad clinical training to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Review medical records, including FHIR data and clinical notes, for AI training.
  2. Check whether clinical information and claims are supported by the medical record.
  3. Review inpatient documentation, including HPI, PMH, assessments, and plans.
  4. Follow clear guidelines and apply the same standards consistently.
  5. Identify missing, incorrect, or inconsistent information in medical records.
  6. Share feedback to help improve AI models and data quality.
  7. Communicate clearly with the project team about your work and findings.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. At least 5 years of hospitalist experience.
  2. MD or DO, board certified in Family Medicine (or Family Medicine with a Hospital Medicine focus or certification).
  3. Current or recent inpatient/hospitalist experience (within the last 2 years).
  4. Strong understanding of inpatient documentation and hospital workflows, including admission, daily progress notes, transitions of care, and discharge.
  5. Comfortable reviewing clinical notes and raw medical record data.
  6. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow clear guidelines consistently.
  7. Experience with chart review, clinical documentation improvement, utilization review, or medical coding/QA is a plus.
  8. Experience across a broad patient mix, such as adult medicine, geriatrics, pediatrics, or obstetric/newborn care, is a plus. Family medicine’s cross-population training is especially valuable here.

How to apply

Apply here with your profile. We will then email you a link to complete yourapplication on the hiring platform — your application is only considered oncethat final step is done.
